subject: Logic
title: Opportunity Cost
description: A short lesson to help you apply Opportunity Cost.

hook.text: You spent Saturday studying. The opportunity cost wasn't money—it was the hike, the nap, and the party you missed.

buildup.text: Opportunity cost is the value of the best alternative you gave up when you chose something else.

discovery.text: Every choice silently kills other possibilities. Ignoring this leads to hidden overspending of time and resources.

twist.text: Thinking in opportunity costs is uncomfortable—it forces you to see what you sacrifice, not just what you gain.

climax.text: Before any commitment, ask: what's the best thing I could do instead? That's your real price.

punchline.text: Every yes is a hidden no.

quiz.question: What is opportunity cost?
options: The value of the best alternative given up
The total cost of all options
